Recommendation: Enable the authentication methods registration campaign (Entra ID > Authentication methods > Registration campaign) with at least one include target, so users are actively nudged to register a stronger method after completing MFA. 'Default'/unset does not reliably mean this is happening. CORRECTED 2026-09-09 (was previously wrong here): earlier guidance said a restricted passkey profile - synced-only, device-bound-only, attestation enforced, or AAGUID key restrictions - suppressed the Microsoft managed nudge entirely. Microsoft's own documentation now describes the opposite for most of these: under 'Microsoft managed' state, a user needs only ONE eligible passkey profile out of Unrestricted, Synced-only, Device-bound-only, AAGUID-restricted (allow-list contains at least one AAGUID for iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, Microsoft Authenticator passkey, or Microsoft Entra passkey on Windows), or Device-bound with attestation enforced - key restrictions aren't even evaluated for that last one. This is an active rollout (Message Center MC1469555, general availability early-to-mid September 2026, Worldwide/GCC, expected complete by end of September 2026) - Microsoft's own page carries a rollout notice that tenant behavior may still lag the documented rules until then, so verify directly rather than assuming this has already taken effect. See PASS001/PASS002 for the corresponding correction on the attestation/key-restriction side, and docs/references.md for the exact sourced wording.
